children: QuasarEdge Acquisition entered into a First Amendment to its Merger Agreement with Robseek to refine key deal terms. The amendment clarifies that each QRED right converts into one-fourth of one Purchaser share at closing, converts the Purchaser to a single-class, one-vote share structure, and updates the shareholder allocation to 100,000,000 closing payment shares. It also revises lock-up terms so shares are restricted until the earlier of 180 days post-close or meeting a $12.50 trading-price condition beginning at least 90 days after closing. The changes are intended to streamline governance and align incentives ahead of the business combination.
